# scatterplots

here are some plots

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

plot_df =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(100, 2, 3),
    y = x + rnorm(100)
  )

plot_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point()
```
